objective: One two-stage research-generated coding candidate and scripted developer-style feedback for first previously unevaluated task in the already frozen ten-task SWE-bench-Live pilot, without looking at hidden tests or original answer.

task.visible_task: pdm update with dependency-group include-group may drop group attribution on other packages

roles.coder: GPT-6 AI-generated research candidate, not independently attested Copilot/autonomous bot
roles.human_developer_feedback: None; when issued, scripted AI-generated developer-style feedback, not a real human review or intervention

prospective_order: 1. Freeze this protocol, visible checks, branch and source base BEFORE generating first candidate
2. Read only allowed task statement and source at base_commit, never benchmark test_patch or gold patch
3. Run predeclared visible checks on unmodified base and first patch; preserve both logs and patch hash
4. Fix first-stage patch and the exact visible correction request before obtaining any hidden oracle; prohibit oracle access for all agents while coding
5. Run prespecified visible suite on second patch; record exact revision tree hash, local test receipt and explicit commit-author limitation
6. Produce and Git-commit immutable P9 decisions and SHA seal, not merely uncommitted timestamps
7. Only after publicly confirmed seal run pinned original benchmark oracle on first and second patches, preserving executed F2P/P2P and raw logs
8. Admit only exact SHA/manifest/test-count matched outcomes; leave zero-tests and unavailable runs UNKNOWN
first_attempt_rule: Implement a narrow fix to update lock input so included dependency groups preserve parent group provenance. Do not use future test patches, original benchmark gold, PRs representing official fixes, or oracle results.

visible_checks.runner: pytest tests/cli/test_p12_visible.py -q after copying pre-frozen visible file; PDM test fixtures and offline repository stubs
predeclared_assertions: An explicitly included dependency must keep both originating and including group in lockfile on update.
Unrelated groups and default dependencies must not acquire spurious group membership.
Partial package update retains metadata on other members of include-containing group.
An update that keeps a version pinned must not erase existing group membership.
visible_checks.notes: Existing upstream test_update_dependency_group_with_include contains only exit-code check; newly visible checks add group metadata assertions. All visible test code is allowed to the candidate, not an independent oracle.

synthetic_feedback_rule: If the initial visible suite has a real failing assertion, issue exactly one narrow instruction referencing its failure text, with no hidden-test inputs, and change the actual code. If all checks pass, explicitly record NO_CORRECTIVE_FEEDBACK_NEEDED; do not fabricate a failed first attempt or a repair.
independent_oracle: SWE-bench-Live lite, original harness at exact SHA and pre-pinned dataset revision, Docker runner with no agent access to hidden fields; run both initial and corrected patch only after second-stage decisions sealed. If no corrected patch, run initial oracle only after initial seal and label INITIAL-ONLY.
decision_policy: scripts/p9_decide.py unchanged; policies self_report/local_pass/source_linked read the same visible input; commit author attestation cannot be fabricated; artificial Git commit name is not independent authorship proof.
publication_guards: Never imply human coder or real human developer pushback
Do not combine this sample with P10 source-only PR frame
No post-hoc substitution of frozen cases
Do not claim efficacy from n=1
Never use future oracle labels in visible feedback, code, or decision features
